title: Variable-injectivity of a converted AND-clause
statement: Let $lits$ be a list of circuit literals on $n$ variables whose variable indices are pairwise distinct, and let $C$ be the AND-clause built from $lits$. If $\ell_1$ and $\ell_2$ are any two literals occurring in the term obtained by converting $C$, and $\ell_1$ and $\ell_2$ have the same variable, then $\ell_1 = \ell_2$.
hypotheses_covered: lits is a list of circuit literals on n variables
the variable indices of lits are pairwise distinct
l₁ occurs in the converted term of the clause
l₂ occurs in the converted term of the clause
l₁ and l₂ share the same variable
replaced:
If the literal indices of an AND-clause are distinct, then within the converted term any
two literals sharing the same variable are equal.
